# A small ice chunk floating in the sea, 0.9 x 0.6 m, 0.14 m above the water. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Snow --base-color 0.769 0.941 0.761 --no-slot
material new Ice --base-color 0.353 0.725 0.659 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Chunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.5 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.9 0.6 1
apply --scale
material assign Ice
active Chunk
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Snow
select vert where "pos.z > 0.1"
randomize --amount 0.04 --seed 11
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export chunk.glb
